clips.title: The story
paras: Athridas Bearmantle waits for word from Starbreeze Village, but the reports have stopped. Great Warden Gaerolas Talvethren watches over the sleeping Druids of the Talon in the Ban'ethil Barrow Den, and his silence points to danger in Teldrassil.

Athridas Bearmantle depends on regular word from Gaerolas Talvethren, the Great Warden watching over the Druids of the Talon in the Ban'ethil Barrow Den. The druids sleep there to keep their sacred pact with Ysera in the Emerald Dream. Their sanctuary matters to the spiritual balance of the young World Tree. Now reports from the east have ceased, and unease spreads through the forest.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A troubling breeze blows through the forest.

Gaerolas Talvethren serves as Great Warden to the hibernating Druids of the Talon in the Ban'ethil Barrow Den. His duty as the chosen protector of the Sleeping is to ensure their safety so that their pact with Ysera remains fulfilled.

But word from Gaerolas is now delayed and I grow nervous. Travel east to Starbreeze Village and bring back a report from Gaerolas so that I can put my worries to rest, knowing my dreaming brethren slumber safely.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank the forest spirits you are here! I knew Athridas would sense trouble and send help.
